description.value: Sushi K Kamizato is an intimate, reservation-only omakase restaurant in Port Coquitlam where Executive Chef Keith Kamizato — originally from Okinawa, Japan — crafts personalized multi-course sushi meals set to a rock music soundtrack. The restaurant is run entirely by Keith and his wife Chika, who aim to create a distinctive, chef-driven experience far removed from standard sushi dining. A touring cyclist looking for a memorable sit-down dinner in the Tri-Cities area would find this a highly unique option.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content clearly confirms an operating omakase sushi restaurant in Port Coquitlam run by Chef Keith Kamizato and his wife Chika; the phone number matches OSM. Two discrepancies require flagging: OSM lists the unit as '2105' while the website contact page says 'unit 2501', and the OSM name 'Sushi Kamizato' differs from the website name 'Sushi K Kamizato'. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with an active website and confirmed phone number; a touring cyclist seeking a distinctive sit-down dinner in Port Coquitlam would find this useful.
